note: Which shadow tier each element rests at, and how its tier moves with state. `built` rows record what the Figma-built registry does today, so the map and the components cannot disagree. `proposed` rows are not built yet. The ladder runs none, base, small, medium, large, xlarge. A tier is a token, --shadow-base to --shadow-xlarge. Checked against data/elevation-map.schema.json by scripts/elevation-map.mjs.

dark.base: No shadow (--shadow-base draws nothing in .dark). The --bg-card fill and the component's own edge carry it.
dark.small: No shadow (--shadow-small draws nothing in .dark). The --elevation-surface-small fill and the component's own edge carry it.
dark.medium: --elevation-surface-raised fill, the blacker --shadow-medium from the Figma Elevation/Dark/Medium style, and the component's own edge.
dark.large: --elevation-surface-raised fill, the blacker --shadow-large from Elevation/Dark/Large, and the component's own edge.
dark.xlarge: --elevation-surface-raised fill, the blacker --shadow-xlarge from Elevation/Dark/XLarge, and the component's own edge.

elements.label: Card
elements.note: Hover and press only apply to a card with a link (CardLink). A static card stays at base.

elements.label: Choice Card
elements.note: Hover and press apply to the resting card only. A checked, negative or disabled card stays at base.

elements.label: Switch knob
elements.note: In dark its Small shadow draws nothing. The knob is a light fill (--switch-knob) on a dark track, so the fill carries it.

elements.label: Dropdown menu
elements.note: The menu does not change tier. Its items change fill.

elements.label: Hover card
elements.note: Drawn from the Figma Popover set, which binds Small.

elements.label: Tooltip
elements.note: The Tooltip is a dark fill (--bg-always-dark) in both themes, so it does not use the raised fill.

elements.label: Dialog
elements.note: Drawn at Large in Figma. XLarge is unused.

elements.label: Right-docked Sheet
elements.note: Not built. Use --shadow-large-right: it falls to the left of the sheet only (DS-ELEVATION-006).

elements.label: Bottom sheet
elements.note: Not built. Use --shadow-large-bottom: it falls above the sheet only (DS-ELEVATION-006).

elements.label: Item being dragged
elements.note: Not built. A dragged item jumps to a high tier while it is held.
